blurb: Guests can visit multiple locations including a brewpub in Monterey, a bistro in Carmel-by-the-Sea, and a taproom in Salinas. They offer fresh craft beers brewed onsite and a menu featuring pub fare made with local ingredients. The venues are family and dog friendly with indoor and outdoor seating depending on location.
extraNote: Beer orders ship only within California; adult signature required for alcohol delivery · Beer orders in multiples of 2 items, max 12 items per order · No returns or exchanges on beer; merchandise returns accepted within 30 days if unused · Reservations accepted for groups under 14 on weekdays at Carmel; no reservations weekends · Salinas Taproom accepts walk-ins for groups 1-10; reservations limited; no groups over 25 · Happy Hour at Salinas Taproom Wed, Thu, Sun 3-6pm with $5 beers and 25% off food
